# clio config set

write one configuration path at a scope

## Usage

```
clio config set PATH VALUE [--scope session|profile|deployment] [--output json|text]
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `PATH` | yes | Dotted configuration path `config set` writes; the `config_set` tool validates it before applying. |
| `VALUE` | yes | Value `config set` stores at the path; decoded as JSON when it parses, otherwise stored as text. |

## Options

| Option | Kind | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--scope session\|profile\|deployment` | enum: session, profile, deployment | `session` | Selects the configuration scope that `config_cli::set_call` passes to the `config_set` tool; `session` is process-local, living only for this command, and the CLI refuses it even though it stays the fallback when the flag is omitted, while `profile` persists the value in the CLI state file and `deployment` persists it in the deployment config file, so a later command reads both. |
| `--output json\|text` | enum: json, text |  | Selects the output mode that `cli_output::resolve_output` returns; the terminal decides it when absent. |

## Global options

| Option | Kind | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--db PATH` | text |  | Overrides the store address that `db_target::resolve_target` opens; config and environment decide it when absent. |
| `--backend sqlite\|postgres` | enum: sqlite, postgres |  | Selects the store backend that `db_target::resolve_target` hands to the resolver; config or the address decides it when absent. |
| `--bank BANK` | text |  | Scopes the command to one bank; `cli_read_args::base_args` passes it to the tool and the write scope defaults to `default`. |
| `--actor ACTOR` | text |  | Names the acting identity; `cli_read_args::base_args` passes it to the tool and `auth_cli` reads it for the actor commands. |
| `--no-input` |  |  | Refuses interactive input; `backup_restore_cli` treats a run with it as non-interactive. |
| `--yes` |  |  | Answers yes to the destructive-confirmation gate that `cli_confirm::confirmed` applies. |

## Examples

Write one path at the deployment scope.
```
clio config set sync.omit true --scope deployment
```

Write the same path at the active profile's scope and report as JSON.
```
clio config set sync.omit true --scope profile -o json
```

Write at the deployment scope and report as JSON.
```
clio config set sync.omit false --scope deployment -o json
```
